name: Sakakibara Kyouko
source: She is the daughter of a wealthy man from a rising conglomerate. She is the calm and perfect student body president, who excels in academics and athletics. She is uptight about morals, but loves her students. She is a member of the horse riding club, and is proud and dislikes weak men.
translation: She is the daughter of a wealthy man from a rising conglomerate. She is the calm and perfect student body president, who excels in academics and athletics. She is uptight about morals, but loves her students. She is a member of the horse riding club, and is proud and dislikes weak men.
